lines.en: label secondbeach9:
scene mollyosako1
: Molly! Wait up!
lines.zh: ：Molly！等等！

lines.en: : What’s going on? What the hell happened in the like, five minutes I was out of the room for?
lines.zh: ：怎么回事？我离开房间才五分钟，到底他妈的发生了什么？

lines.en: : Stop following me!
lines.zh: ：别跟着我！

lines.en: : No! If you’re feeling down, it’s okay to talk about it!
lines.zh: ：不！你要是难过，说出来也没关系的！

lines.en: : Uhh, Molly? I have no idea what happened, but Ayane is right.
lines.zh: ：呃，Molly？我不知道发生了什么，但 Ayane 说得对。

lines.en: : I’m sure that whatever it is is just temporary. Life is too short to spend on negative emotions like this.
lines.zh: ：我敢肯定，不管是什么事，都只是暂时的。人生太短，不该浪费在这种负面情绪上。

lines.en: : I frickin’ know that! I just wanna cry alone!
lines.zh: ：我他妈当然知道！我只是想一个人哭一会儿！

lines.en: scene mollyosako2
: Mind cluing me in on what happened exactly? Molly’s kinda got a right to cry by herself if she wants to.
lines.zh: ：能告诉我到底发生了什么吗？Molly 想一个人哭，也是有这个权利的。

lines.en: : I know, I know. That’s what I do to handle basically everything ever.
lines.zh: ：我知道，我知道。我基本上什么事都是这么处理的。

lines.en: : But there’s clearly a little more going on than just her wanting to cry...and I want to make sure it isn’t something that’s going to wind up ruining or destroying any friendships in the process.
lines.zh: ：但显然不只是她想哭那么简单……我想确认一下，这件事最后不会毁掉什么友谊。

lines.en: scene mollyosako3
: I’m not destroying anything! It’s not me!
lines.zh: ：我没有在毁掉什么！不是我的问题！

lines.en: : That’s not what I was saying, Molly...
lines.zh: ：我不是那个意思，Molly……

lines.en: : Rin’s the one who shouldn’t have gotten mad! It’s {i}my{/i} campaign that {i}I{/i} made for {i}us!{/i}
lines.zh: ：该生气的人不是 Rin！那是{i}我{/i}为{i}我们大家{/i}做的战役！

lines.en: : Yeah, it might be kind of immature! But it’s really important to me and she clearly doesn’t care about it!
lines.zh: ：对，可能有点幼稚！但它对我来说真的很重要，而她显然根本不在乎！

lines.en: : I think Rin cares, Molly. She just-
lines.zh: ：我觉得 Rin 是在乎的，Molly。她只是——

lines.en: scene mollyosako4
: What do you know?! You weren’t even there!
lines.zh: ：你懂什么？！你当时根本不在场！

lines.en: : Uhh...right. Good point.
lines.zh: ：呃……也对。说得没错。

lines.en: : She’s right, though. Rin really does care.
lines.zh: ：不过她说得对。Rin 真的很在乎。

lines.en: : About the campaign. About spending time with everyone.
lines.zh: ：在乎这个战役。在乎和大家待在一起。

lines.en: : About you.
lines.zh: ：在乎你。

lines.en: : She just wanted to share some of that fun with a new friend of hers. And all of us were okay with it.
lines.zh: ：她只是想和她的新朋友分享那份快乐。而我们所有人都无所谓啊。

lines.en: : You normally {i}love{/i} the idea of anyone joining in on the campaign. How come Otoha was an exception to that?
lines.zh: ：你平时最{i}喜欢{/i}有人加入战役了。为什么 Otoha 就成了例外？

lines.en: : I...I don’t have to explain myself to you!
lines.zh: ：我……我不需要向你解释！

lines.en: : No, you don’t.
lines.zh: ：对，你不需要。

lines.en: : But I’d really appreciate it if you tried.
lines.zh: ：但如果你愿意试试，我会很感激。

lines.en: scene mollyosako5
: {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: I don’t think my charisma is high enough to get it out in a way that will make sense.
lines.zh: ：我觉得我的魅力值不够高，说出来的话没法让人听懂。

lines.en: : This was just the one thing I didn’t think would be touched by...someone else.
lines.zh: ：这只是我唯一一件以为不会被……别人碰的东西。

lines.en: : Was I mean? Maybe a little bit. But you’re on {i}my{/i} side, right?
lines.zh: ：我很过分吗？也许有一点。但你们是站在{i}我{/i}这边的，对吧？

lines.en: : Like...letting someone else just jump in like that defeats the purpose of the...campaign, and...
lines.zh: ：就是……让别人就这么插进来，根本就违背了……战役的意义，而且……

lines.en: : Why do there have to be sides?
lines.zh: ：为什么非得分边站？

lines.en: : Why can’t we just go back, apologize to Otoha for yelling at her, and then keep playing?
lines.zh: ：我们为什么不能就这么回去，为对她吼的事跟 Otoha 道歉，然后接着玩？

lines.en: : You were looking forward to this, weren’t you? Just like all of {i}us{/i} were looking forward to it.
lines.zh: ：你不是很期待这一天的吗？就像{i}我们{/i}所有人一样期待。

lines.en: : We don’t want to let something like this get in the way of that.
lines.zh: ：我们不想让这种事坏了它。

lines.en: scene mollyosako6
: You think {i}I’m{/i} the one who should apologize?
lines.zh: ：你觉得该道歉的人是{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : Not for getting upset, of course not. But you yelled at someone who basically just sat there and took it.
lines.zh: ：不是为难过道歉，当然不是。但你冲一个基本上只是坐在那里默默承受的人吼了。

lines.en: : Otoha gave up on playing as soon as you said you didn’t want her to. She was just going to watch.
lines.zh: ：你一说不想让她玩，Otoha 就放弃了。她只是打算看着。

lines.en: : And Sensei’s watched us a few times in the past, so there’s clearly no problem with being spectated.
lines.zh: ：而且 Sensei 以前也看过我们几次，所以被人观战显然没什么问题。

lines.en: : I just don’t understand why you’re acting like this all of a sudden.
lines.zh: ：我只是不明白你为什么突然变成这样。

lines.en: : It’s a free country! I can cry if I want and I don’t have to explain myself!
lines.zh: ：这是自由的国家！我想哭就哭，我不需要解释！

lines.en: : You’re not understanding, Molly. It’s fine to cry, but not when it’s going to hurt other-
lines.zh: ：你没听懂，Molly。哭没关系，但如果会伤害到别人就不行——

lines.en: : Sorry, Ayane. But I think I might know what’s going on here.
lines.zh: ：抱歉，Ayane。但我想我可能知道是怎么回事了。

lines.en: scene mollyosako7
: What could you possibly know? You weren’t even in the room for two minutes.
lines.zh: ：你能知道什么？你连两分钟都没在房间里待过。

lines.en: : So you’re {i}not{/i} jealous of Otoha because Rin is crushing on her?
lines.zh: ：那你对 Otoha 的嫉妒，{i}不是{/i}因为 Rin 在暗恋她？

lines.en: scene mollyosako8
: Wha-
: I...I have no idea what you’re talking about!
lines.zh: ：我……我完全不知道你在说什么！

lines.en: : Oh my God...
lines.zh: ：我的天……

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: ：当然……

lines.en: : How didn’t I notice?
lines.zh: ：我怎么就没发现呢？

lines.en: : That would explain everything.
lines.zh: ：这就说得通了。

lines.en: : Molly, we’re three girls alone on the beach. We’re not going to judge you for having a crush on a friend.
lines.zh: ：Molly，我们现在是海滩上独处的三个女生。你暗恋一个朋友，我们不会因此评判你。

lines.en: : I don’t have a crush on anyone!
lines.zh: ：我没有暗恋任何人！

lines.en: : Are you denying it because she’s a friend? Or because she’s a girl?
lines.zh: ：你否认，是因为她是朋友？还是因为她是女生？

lines.en: : Because if you’re worried about the latter part, I like girls too. That sort of thing just happens at all girls[school]s...and in the world in general.
lines.zh: ：如果你担心的是后者，我也喜欢女生。这种事在全是女生的[school]里很常见……在全世界也都一样。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to be ashamed of.
lines.zh: ：没什么好羞耻的。

lines.en: : I’m not ashamed of anything! Stop following me!
lines.zh: ：我一点都不觉得羞耻！别跟着我！

lines.en: scene mollyosako9
: Molly...I’m so sorry I didn’t notice earlier. I wouldn’t have even chased after you if I knew that’s what it was.
lines.zh: ：Molly……我很抱歉我早没发现。我要是知道是这个原因，根本不会追出来。

lines.en: : I never said that’s what it was.
lines.zh: ：我从没说过是这么回事。

lines.en: : Well, if I’m making a mistake, I’m really sorry.
lines.zh: ：好吧，如果我猜错了，那我真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : But, to anyone out there who might be listening in from behind a tree or something, it’s okay to like whoever you want.
lines.zh: ：不过，对于可能正躲在树后面什么的偷听的人，我想说：喜欢谁都可以。

lines.en: : You don’t have to feel bad about it just because they’re interested in someone else.
lines.zh: ：不必因为他们喜欢上了别人，就觉得自己不该有这份心思。

lines.en: : Sometimes, the hardest ones to get are worth the chase. Even when you know it’s going to hurt at times.
lines.zh: ：有时候，最难追到的人反而值得去追。哪怕你知道有时候会受伤。

lines.en: scene mollyosako10
: Right, Ayane?
lines.zh: ：对吧，Ayane？

lines.en: : Huh?
: What? You and I are rivals in love.
lines.zh: ：怎么？你和我可是情敌啊。

lines.en: : You don’t mean to tell me that I’m the only one that's been getting jealous whenever Sensei is with other girls, do you?
lines.zh: ：你该不会想告诉我，只有我一个人在 Sensei 跟别的女生在一起时会吃醋吧？

lines.en: scene mollyosako11
: No. You're definitely not.
lines.zh: ：不。你绝对不是唯一一个。

lines.en: : In fact, even the thought of you knowing him longer than me makes me sick to my stomach.
lines.zh: ：事实上，光是想到你认识他比我还早，我就恶心到想吐。

lines.en: : But I’m not ashamed to follow my heart. And I know that I have a better chance at ending up with Sensei than anyone.
lines.zh: ：但我并不羞于遵从自己的心。而且我知道，我最后和 Sensei 在一起的机会比任何人都大。

lines.en: : And I wish you luck in that regard.
lines.zh: ：这方面我祝你好运。

lines.en: : But I’m going to beat you.
lines.zh: ：不过我会赢过你的。

lines.en: scene mollyosako12
: See, Molly? If Ayane and I can have feelings for someone without destroying any relationships in the process, what’s stopping you from owning up to your feelings as well?
lines.zh: ：看到了吗，Molly？如果我和 Ayane 都能在不动摇任何关系的前提下对一个人有感觉，你又为什么不能坦承自己的感情呢？

lines.en: : Unless I actually {i}am{/i} wrong and you don’t like Rin. If that’s really the case, this is probably a very awkward situation for you right now.
lines.zh: ：除非我真的猜错了，你其实不喜欢 Rin。如果真{i}是{/i}那样，那你现在大概尴尬死了。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: I’m not admitting anything, but...
lines.zh: ：我什么都不会承认，不过……

lines.en: : I’m...flattered you two have followed me this far...
lines.zh: ：你们两个跟着我走了这么远，我……很感动……

lines.en: : But...in the event that I actually {i}did{/i}...feel that way about her...it would be a much different scenario...
lines.zh: ：但是……万一我{i}真的{/i}……对她有那种感情……情况会完全不一样……

lines.en: : You two have loved Sensei for as long as you can remember.
lines.zh: ：你们两个从记事起就爱着 Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m not even a romanceable character in Rin’s metaphorical eroge. That’s how far off the map I am in her eyes.
lines.zh: ：我连 Rin 那部比喻意义上的 eroge 里的可攻略角色都算不上。在她眼里，我就偏得这么离谱。

lines.en: : That’s not true.
lines.zh: ：才不是。

lines.en: : Even if you two are just friends, I’m sure she’s at least rubbed one out to some kinda fantasy of you before.
lines.zh: ：就算你们只是朋友，我敢肯定她至少也对着关于你的某种幻想撸过一发。

lines.en: : That sorta thing is just inevitable at the end of the day.
lines.zh: ：说到底这种事是躲不掉的。

lines.en: : Hell, even {i}I’ve{/i} rubbed one out to you before and we’ve only talked like two or three times.
lines.zh: ：操，连{i}我{/i}都对着你撸过一发，而我们才说过两三次话。

lines.en: scene mollyosako13
: I...beg your pardon?
lines.zh: ：我……你说什么？

lines.en: : You too, Ayane.
lines.zh: ：你也一样，Ayane。

lines.en: : Sensei was there for that fantasy, though.
lines.zh: ：不过那次幻想里有 Sensei 在场。

lines.en: scene mollyosako14
: Uhh...I think what Noriko is trying to say is that...nothing is impossible!
lines.zh: ：呃……我觉得 Noriko 想说的是……没有什么是不可能的！

lines.en: : And even if you’re feeling like an undisclosed friend of yours that you may or may not have feelings for is out of reach...he or she never really is!
lines.zh: ：就算你觉得那个你不愿透露姓名、可能有也可能没有感情的朋友遥不可及……他或她也从来没有真的遥不可及过！

lines.en: : Yeah! That!
lines.zh: ：对！就是这个！

lines.en: scene mollyosako15
: Hah...
: You two are clearly less versed in the world of RPGs than I am, so allow me to do a little bit of explaining.
lines.zh: ：你们两个显然没有我懂 RPG 的世界，那就让我稍微解释一下。

lines.en: : There are many boss fights out there in which the player character is scripted to lose.
lines.zh: ：有很多 Boss 战，玩家角色是注定要输的。

lines.en: : And if I {i}am{/i} feeling like an undisclosed friend of mine that I may or may not have feelings for is out of reach...he or she really is.
lines.zh: ：所以如果我觉得那个我不愿透露、可能有也可能没有感情的朋友遥不可及……那他或她就{i}是{/i}真的遥不可及。

lines.en: : Do you know how it feels to share clothes with the person you secretly love?
lines.zh: ：你们知道和自己偷偷爱着的人换衣服穿是什么感觉吗？

lines.en: : To help fit them for costumes, hiding the redness of your face and how easily it gives away your intentions or desires?
lines.zh: ：帮她们试穿戏服，努力藏住脸上的红晕，藏住它有多容易出卖你的心思和欲望？

lines.en: : To smell the scent of her lotion when she puts it on in your dorm room?
lines.zh: ：她在你宿舍里涂润肤乳时，闻到那股香味？

lines.en: : Or how to rid your brain of the image of her as she storms into the shower and asks to borrow your conditioner?
lines.zh: ：或者该怎么把那个画面从脑子里赶走——她冲进淋浴间，问你要护发素借用？

lines.en: : How she sees or feels {i}nothing{/i} for you, but {i}everything{/i} for everyone else?
lines.zh: ：她对你{i}毫无感觉{/i}，却对其他所有人都{i}倾尽所有{/i}？

lines.en: : This is all rhetorical, of course.
lines.zh: ：当然，这些都是反问。

lines.en: : I’m just basing this off of...some game I played.
lines.zh: ：我只是拿……我玩过的某个游戏当例子。

lines.en: : Again, she’s totally fingered herself to some kind of fantasy of you before. I can promise that’s a thing.
lines.zh: ：再说一遍，她绝对曾经对着关于你的某种幻想用手指弄过自己。我可以打包票。

lines.en: scene mollyosako16
: I think that might just be a {i}you{/i} thing, Noriko.
lines.zh: ：我觉得这可能只是{i}你{/i}自己的癖好，Noriko。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: ：真的吗？

lines.en: : Look me in the eyes and tell me with a straight face you’ve never [masturbate]d to me before.
lines.zh: ：看着我的眼睛，一本正经地告诉我，你从来没有对着我[masturbate]过。

lines.en: scene mollyosako17
: I’m sorry. But I just love Sensei so much that those fantasies are reserved for him and him only.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。可我太爱 Sensei 了，那些幻想只留给他，也只属于他一个人。

lines.en: : Oh you son of a bitch.
lines.zh: ：哦你这个婊子养的。

lines.en: : If you are going to follow me around the beach...could you perhaps attempt to avoid the discussion of your...self-pleasure habits?
lines.zh: ：如果你们非要跟着我在海滩上走……能不能尽量避免谈论你们的……自娱自乐的习惯？

lines.en: scene mollyosako18
: Oooookay. Looks like I may have picked a weird time to go for a walk.
lines.zh: ：好——吧。看来我挑了个不太妙的时机出来散步。

lines.en: : Osako! Perfect!
lines.zh: ：Osako！正好！

lines.en: scene mollyosako19
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: ：啊？什么？

lines.en: : What’s perfect?
lines.zh: ：什么正好？

lines.en: : I don’t really want to talk about...{i}that{/i} sort of thing with girls your age.
lines.zh: ：我可不太想和你们这个年纪的女生聊……{i}那种{/i}事。

lines.en: : Can you at least confirm that it’s normal for friends to [masturbate] to other friends? I’m trying to prove a point.
lines.zh: ：你能至少确认一下，朋友之间对着朋友[masturbate]是正常的吗？我在试图证明一个观点。

lines.en: scene mollyosako20
: Uhh...what?
lines.zh: ：呃……什么？

lines.en: : Ayane...I was okay with you two following me around, but a person I’ve never met before is-
lines.zh: ：Ayane……你们两个跟着我我还能接受，但一个我从来没见过的人——

lines.en: : Is even better! Here. Come.
lines.zh: ：那就更好了！来。过来。

lines.en: : Hey! Wait!
lines.zh: ：喂！等等！

lines.en: scene mollyosako21
: If you have no idea who a person is, wouldn’t that make it a little easier to talk to them about this?
lines.zh: ：如果你根本不认识一个人，那跟他聊这种事不是更容易开口吗？

lines.en: : Your worry seems to be about ruining relationships- but without a relationship to ruin, what’s there to be afraid of?
lines.zh: ：你担心的是会毁掉关系——可如果没有关系可以毁，那还有什么好怕的？

lines.en: : Can someone tell me what’s going on here? Because all I know is that this involves self-pleasure and strangers and those are two big red flags.
lines.zh: ：谁能告诉我现在是什么情况？因为我只知道这涉及自慰和陌生人，而这两样都是大大的红旗。

lines.en: scene mollyosako22
: My friend here may or may not have undisclosed feelings for an undisclosed friend of an undisclosed gender.
lines.zh: ：我这位朋友可能对一位不愿透露姓名、性别也不愿透露的朋友，怀有不愿透露的感情。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, you’ve certainly bumped into the right person, then.
lines.zh: ：那你们可真是撞对人了。

lines.en: : Can you maybe talk to her for a little while? Just to kinda help her take her mind off of things.
lines.zh: ：你能不能陪她聊一会儿？就当帮她分散一下注意力。

lines.en: : I...don’t want to talk...
lines.zh: ：我……不想说话……

lines.en: : Then don’t.
lines.zh: ：那就别说。

lines.en: : But, as someone who was very likely in the same position as you at one point, I’d be fine with sitting next to you in silence for a little while.
lines.zh: ：不过，作为一个很可能曾经和你处境相同的人，我很乐意就这么安静地陪你坐一会儿。

lines.en: : Kinda why I’m out here in the first place.
lines.zh: ：其实我出来散步本来也是为了这个。

lines.en: scene mollyosako23
: Do you...
: Do you like video games?
lines.zh: ：你喜欢电子游戏吗？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhh I’m...really good at pinball?
lines.zh: ：呃呃呃呃呃呃我……弹珠台打得特别好？

lines.en: scene mollyosako24
: Hah...I guess I’ll take what I can get...
lines.zh: ：哈……看来也只能将就了……

lines.en: scene black
scene mollyosako25
: I feel like such an idiot.
lines.zh: ：我觉得自己真是个白痴。

lines.en: : For not realizing the Rin thing?
lines.zh: ：因为没发现 Rin 那件事？

lines.en: : It’s so obvious in hindsight.
lines.zh: ：现在回想起来，简直明显得要命。

lines.en: : Rin’s consistently the first person Molly asks to do anything with.
lines.zh: ：Molly 不管要做什么，第一个找的人永远是 Rin。

lines.en: : And whenever she’s not around, Molly’s mood totally changes.
lines.zh: ：而她不在的时候，Molly 的心情就会完全变掉。

lines.en: : Kinda like she’s distracted or...something like that.
lines.zh: ：有点像心不在焉……之类的。

lines.en: : And all this time I thought it was just because the two of them were close, but...
lines.zh: ：我一直以为只是因为她们俩关系好，但是……

lines.en: : So...I obviously wasn’t around for whatever went down-
lines.zh: ：那个……发生的事我显然没赶上——

lines.en: : But how did Otoha handle it?
lines.zh: ：但 Otoha 是怎么应对的？

lines.en: scene mollyosako26
: Like anyone would have, I guess.
lines.zh: ：大概是任何人都会有的反应吧。

lines.en: : She didn’t really say anything. She just kind of sat there and let Molly go off on her.
lines.zh: ：她什么也没说。就那么坐着，任由 Molly 冲她发作。

lines.en: : Rin was the one who started getting Molly really heated up when she stuck up for her instead of just letting her get yelled at.
lines.zh: ：Rin 站出来替她说话、而不是眼睁睁看她挨骂，Molly 才是从那时候真正上头的。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: ：这样啊……

lines.en: : Do you know what they’re up to now?
lines.zh: ：你知道她们现在在干什么吗？

lines.en: : No clue. I chased after Molly as soon as she stormed out.
lines.zh: ：不清楚。Molly 一冲出去我就追出来了。

lines.en: : I imagine they’re probably still in the room.
lines.zh: ：我猜她们大概还在房间里。

lines.en: : Gotcha...
lines.zh: ：明白了……

lines.en: scene mollyosako27
: Have you really [masturbate]d to me before?
lines.zh: ：你真的曾经对着我[masturbate]过？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Why would I lie about that?
lines.zh: ：当然。我干嘛要拿这个撒谎？

lines.en: : That just seems...so random.
lines.zh: ：这也太……莫名其妙了吧。

lines.en: : Hm.
: Well, like I said, Sensei was there too.
lines.zh: ：嗯，就像我说的，那次幻想里 Sensei 也在。

lines.en: : Have you really not had any threesome fantasies?
lines.zh: ：你真的从来没有过三人行的幻想吗？

lines.en: scene mollyosako28
: Not really, no.
lines.zh: ：真没有。

lines.en: : I think girls are cute, but I’m not really sexually attracted to them.
lines.zh: ：我觉得女生很可爱，但我对她们没什么性方面的兴趣。

lines.en: : I’d probably be willing to do something like that as long as Sensei is there, but I’d never really go out of my way to seek one out.
lines.zh: ：只要 Sensei 在场，我大概也愿意做那种事，但我绝对不会特意去找。

lines.en: : So like...
: Have you and Sensei actually...you know.
lines.zh: ：你和 Sensei 真的……那个过吗。

lines.en: scene mollyosako29
: Have we what?
lines.zh: ：我们什么？

lines.en: : Like...had sex?
lines.zh: ：就是……上床？

lines.en: : Or done anything together, really.
lines.zh: ：或者，真的做过点什么。

lines.en: scene mollyosako30
: Why? Are you jealous?
lines.zh: ：怎么？你吃醋了？

lines.en: : Well...yeah.
lines.zh: ：嗯……是啊。

lines.en: : You’re really pretty. And you clearly love him a lot.
lines.zh: ：你真的很漂亮。而且你显然很爱他。

lines.en: : And...in a lot of ways...you kind of became the new “me” once I wasn’t around anymore.
lines.zh: ：而且……在很多方面……我不在之后，你有点变成了新的「我」。

lines.en: : So I’m definitely jealous.
lines.zh: ：所以我当然嫉妒。

lines.en: : Like, I spent all of these years trying to turn myself into what I imagined he wanted out of a girl.
lines.zh: ：比如，我花了这么多年，拼命把自己变成我想象中他想要的那种女孩。

lines.en: : But then I look at you and then back at myself and can’t help but think, “Did he maybe...change?”
lines.zh: ：可我看看你，再看看自己，就会忍不住想：「他是不是……变了？」

lines.en: scene mollyosako31
: He changes all the time.
lines.zh: ：他一直在变。

lines.en: : With every single person and every single situation.
lines.zh: ：对每一个人、每一种情况都在变。

lines.en: : But I know from all of the time I’ve spent with him that he’d never want us to be anything other than who we already are.
lines.zh: ：但和他相处了这么久，我知道他从来不会希望我们变成别的样子，只希望我们做自己。

lines.en: : And, if I’m being honest-
lines.zh: ：而且，说实话——

lines.en: : I’m really jealous of you too.
lines.zh: ：我也很嫉妒你。

lines.en: : But not jealous enough to [masturbate] to me.
lines.zh: ：但还没嫉妒到会对我[masturbate]的程度。

lines.en: : No, Noriko.
lines.zh: ：没有，Noriko。

lines.en: : Not jealous enough to [masturbate] to you.
lines.zh: ：没嫉妒到会对你[masturbate]的程度。

lines.en: scene black
scene mollyosako32
: Are you really just going to sit there?
lines.zh: ：你真的就打算这么坐着？

lines.en: : This is what you wanted, isn’t it?
lines.zh: ：这不正是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : Sometimes, the best way to make yourself feel better is to take a deep breath and just reflect on the things you could have done differently.
lines.zh: ：有时候，让自己好受起来的最好办法，就是深吸一口气，好好反思一下哪些事你本可以做得不一样。

lines.en: : But I don’t really know what I could have done differently.
lines.zh: ：但我真不知道我本可以怎么做才不一样。

lines.en: scene mollyosako33
: Well...what did you do in the first place?
lines.zh: ：那么……你到底做了什么？

lines.en: : Nothing, really.
lines.zh: ：真的什么都没做。

lines.en: : There’s your answer then.
lines.zh: ：那答案就在这儿了。

lines.en: : I...don’t get it.
lines.zh: ：我……不明白。

lines.en: : Well, uhh...like I said, I’m kind of a pinball person and not a game person, but I know enough about some older ones that I can probably cook up some kind of metaphor.
lines.zh: ：嗯……就像我说的，我是玩弹珠台的，不是玩电子游戏的，不过我对一些老游戏还算了解，大概能编出个比喻来。

lines.en: : You know those little block things in Mario Kart that give you turtle shells and shit once you drive into ‘em?
lines.zh: ：你知道马力欧卡丁车里那种小方块吗？撞上去就会给你龟壳什么的。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: ：当然。

lines.en: : Well...you can’t ever really come in first place if you don’t use those powerups, right?
lines.zh: ：那个……你要是不用那些道具，就永远拿不到第一名，对吧？

lines.en: : And if you don’t use 'em shortly after you get them, you’ll wind up passing by other blocks and missing out on {i}more{/i} of the powerups.
lines.zh: ：而且如果你拿到之后不赶紧用掉，就会从别的方块旁边开过去，错过{i}更{/i}多道具。

lines.en: : That’s kinda what love is like.
lines.zh: ：爱情大概就是这么回事。

lines.en: : If you don’t jump on every single opportunity to try and put yourself in a better position, everyone is gonna just cruise right by you.
lines.zh: ：如果你不抓住每一个机会，努力把自己放到更好的位置上，所有人都会从你身边呼啸而过。

lines.en: scene mollyosako34
: For a long while, that’s kind of...exactly what I did.
lines.zh: ：有很长一段时间，我做的……正是这种事。

lines.en: : There was this one girl I was head over heels in love with.
lines.zh: ：曾经有个女孩，让我神魂颠倒。

lines.en: : And it was really scary at first...you know, trying to get her to understand that I saw her as more than just...her.
lines.zh: ：一开始真的很可怕……你知道，要让她明白，我眼里的她不止是……她本人。

lines.en: : But...as time went by, the desire to hold her and make her mine just started festering and eating me alive from the inside out.
lines.zh: ：可是……随着时间过去，那种想抱住她、让她属于我的渴望开始溃烂，从内到外把我活活吃掉。

lines.en: : And the first turtle shell box thing I ever encountered was some poetry assignment we had in[school].
lines.zh: ：而我遇到的第一个「龟壳方块」，是我们在[school]的一次诗歌作业。

lines.en: scene mollyosako35
: She loved poetry.
lines.zh: ：她很爱诗。

lines.en: : Well, still loves. It’s one of her favorite things.
lines.zh: ：嗯，现在也爱。那是她最喜欢的东西之一。

lines.en: : But...dorky old me back then was like...what if I memorized something she’d like and...maybe made eye contact with her or something while reading it?
lines.zh: ：但是……当年那个书呆子的我就想……要不我背一首她会喜欢的东西，然后……朗读的时候跟她对个眼神什么的？

lines.en: : So I did. Eye contact and all.
lines.zh: ：然后我就这么做了。眼神什么的都齐了。

lines.en: : And the second her eyes met mine...it became an addiction.
lines.zh: ：而就在她的目光对上我的那一刻……这就上瘾了。

lines.en: : I started finding every fuckin’ turtle shell I could get my hands on, frantically pushing buttons and moving from one place to the next trying to get her to notice me.
lines.zh: ：我开始去找每一个能搞到手的该死的龟壳，疯狂地按按钮，从一个地方挪到另一个地方，只想让她注意到我。

lines.en: : If I’d never started taking that approach...
lines.zh: ：如果我从来没有开始那样做……

lines.en: : Well, I don’t really know if I’d be here today.
lines.zh: ：嗯，我真不知道我今天还会不会在这儿。

lines.en: scene mollyosako36
: You...contemplated suicide?
lines.zh: ：你……想过自杀？

lines.en: : What? Oh. No. Sorry. I just meant that...we literally came here today together.
lines.zh: ：什么？哦。不是。抱歉。我只是说……我们今天真的是一起来的。

lines.en: : And she’s here as a chaperone, so...
lines.zh: ：而她是以监护人身份来的，所以……

lines.en: : Chap-
lines.zh: ：监护——

lines.en: scene mollyosako37
: Are you Miss Watabe’s girlfriend?!
lines.zh: ：你是 Watabe 老师的女朋友？！

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: ：是的。

lines.en: : But I never would have become that without working for it.
lines.zh: ：但如果我没有为此努力，我永远也当不成。

lines.en: : Wow...
: You are...not at all what I was expecting.
lines.zh: ：你……和我预想的完全不一样。

lines.en: : Yeah...I get that a lot.
lines.zh: ：是啊……这话我听了不少。

lines.en: scene mollyosako38
: This, uhh...{i}undisclosed friend{/i} of yours...
lines.zh: ：这位，呃……你{i}不愿透露的朋友{/i}……

lines.en: : Does she have a name?
lines.zh: ：她有名字吗？

lines.en: : She doesn’t exist. But if she did, her name would likely be something like...Ren or...Ran...
lines.zh: ：她不存在的。但如果她存在的话，她的名字大概会像是……Ren……或者 Ran……

lines.en: : Well, whatever her name {i}would{/i} be, some people just won’t understand things unless you tell them.
lines.zh: ：不管她叫什么名字，有些事你不说，人家就是不{i}会{/i}懂。

lines.en: : And if you want her to know, that might be what you have to do.
lines.zh: ：如果你想让她知道，也许你就得这么做。

lines.en: : What do I do if I {i}don’t{/i} want her to know?
lines.zh: ：如果我{i}不想{/i}让她知道呢？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t you want her to know?
lines.zh: ：为什么不想让她知道？

lines.en: : Because I’m not her type.
lines.zh: ：因为我不是她喜欢的类型。

lines.en: : And it might make things weird.
lines.zh: ：而且可能会让事情变得很尴尬。

lines.en: : Aren’t things weird now?
lines.zh: ：现在难道不尴尬吗？

lines.en: : Only because I made them that way.
lines.zh: ：只是因为是我把它弄成这样的。

lines.en: : Then you’ve got two options. Either apologize and move past it-
lines.zh: ：那你就两个选择。要么道歉，然后翻篇——

lines.en: : Or make things even weirder and hope that she’s a weird enough person to not inherently hate it.
lines.zh: ：要么把事情弄得更尴尬，然后指望她也是个够怪的人，不会本能地讨厌。

lines.en: scene mollyosako39
: She {i}is{/i} pretty weird...
lines.zh: ：她{i}确实{/i}挺怪的……

lines.en: : Or would be if she actually existed. Which she doesn’t.
lines.zh: ：如果她真的存在的话。但她不存在。

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: ：我信你。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, all you can really do is try. Maybe it works out, maybe it doesn’t.
lines.zh: ：说到底，你能做的也只有去试。也许成了，也许没成。

lines.en: : But if you’re already wandering down the beach crying and talking to strangers, I think it’s safe to say that, as-is, things {i}aren’t{/i} working out.
lines.zh: ：但如果你已经开始在海滩上边哭边游荡、还跟陌生人搭话了，我觉得可以肯定地说，照现在这样下去，事情是{i}走不通{/i}的。

lines.en: : And that, personally, I’d try to do something about it.
lines.zh: ：所以换作是我，我会试着做点什么。

lines.en: : Thank you, Miss Watabe’s girlfriend.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你，Watabe 老师的女朋友。

lines.en: : Osako.
lines.zh: ：叫我 Osako。

lines.en: : Thank you, Osako.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你，Osako。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it, random upset foreigner girl.
lines.zh: ：不用谢，随便遇上的、正在难过的外国女孩。

lines.en: : Molly.
lines.zh: ：我叫 Molly。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it, Molly.
lines.zh: ：不用谢，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyosako40
: Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’d like to silently stare at the stars reflecting off of the water for a little while longer before heading back to my room.
lines.zh: ：那么，请恕我失陪，我想再静静地看一会儿倒映在水面上的星星，然后再回房间。

lines.en: : But if you ever need someone to talk to and there isn’t a beach around to bump into randoms, Ayane’s a good bet as well.
lines.zh: ：不过要是哪天你想找人聊聊、附近又没有海滩可以撞上陌生人的话，Ayane 也是个不错的选择。

lines.en: : She can be a little pushy, but she’s got a good heart.
lines.zh: ：她有时候有点强人所难，但她心地很好。

lines.en: : I know...
lines.zh: ：我知道……

lines.en: : Her wisdom is rather high for a rogue as well.
lines.zh: ：作为一个盗贼，她的感知也相当高。

lines.en: : Sure. Whatever that means.
lines.zh: ：行吧。随便那是什么意思。

lines.en: : You’re welcome to stay here, you know. Being broody and reflective is surprisingly helpful at times like this.
lines.zh: ：你想留在这儿也行，知道吗。在这种时候，闷着头沉思意外地很有用。

lines.en: scene mollyosako41
: I suppose a fair bit of brooding won’t do any harm if it’s only occasional.
lines.zh: ：我觉得偶尔闷一会儿也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Though, it’s hard for me to look up at the stars without grieving over the destruction of Alderaan.
lines.zh: ：不过，我仰望星空的时候，总会忍不住为奥德兰的毁灭而哀悼。

lines.en: : Oh. Alderaan is-
lines.zh: ：哦。奥德兰是——

lines.en: : Star Wars. I know.
lines.zh: ：《星球大战》。我知道。

lines.en: : Rip in peace, Alderaan.
lines.zh: ：安息吧，奥德兰。

lines.en: : Rip in peace...
lines.zh: ：安息吧……

{i}Somewhere else...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在别的地方……{/i}
